text: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE INPUT — NOT A REAL PAPER.
Hand-written for the minimal example of citation-support-auditor.
Planted defects (described here without citation syntax so this header does not register as citations): the third numbered citation is used but never listed;
the fourth numbered reference is listed but never cited;
one author-year citation by Wang is missing from the reference list;
one over-strong claim hides behind a citation.
Biochar and Soil Moisture: A Mini Study  Abstract Biochar can change soil water retention.
We tested one soil and one biochar dose.
Introduction Biochar improves water retention in sandy soils [1].
Zhang et al. (2018) reviewed the field.
Wang et al. (2021) showed dose effects matter.
Methods We followed the pot protocol of [1].
Moisture was measured gravimetrically at day 7 and day 14.
Results Moisture was 18% higher in treated pots at day 7.
Discussion Our single-soil result echoes earlier reports [2].
The cure claim in the introduction rests entirely on its citation and should be checked.
